text:
Maya C: alert from snapshot-watch: object tenant-77/db-snap-20260510.tar.gz has Metadata.encrypted=false. noticed after a policy harden at ~03:50 UTC.

deploy-bot: snapshot-checker alert: missing-sse detected tenant=tenant-77 key=db-snap-20260510.tar.gz time=2026-05-10T03:58:12Z :warning:

Arun P: Did we rotate/upload role bindings this morning? I pushed a small IAM tighten at 03:48 to remove an unused assume-role.

Maya C: yes that was me. I removed vendor/legacy-agent from snapshot-uploader binding. Thought the fleet was on v2 agents already.

Sasha L: quick head-object shows no SSE headers. ran `aws s3api head-object --bucket redwood-snapshots-prod --key tenant-77/db-snap-20260510.tar.gz` -> metadata empty.

Arun P: KMS logs show a GrantRevoke at 03:49:05 UTC for CMK arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/aa11. Looks correlated.

Maya C: encops-bot, create incident please.

encops-bot: incident-created id=INC-20260510-01 severity=high assignees=eng-security,eng-sre :rotating_light:

Sasha L: Forensics: identify uploader host/instance and agent version. If it was legacy agent it might be failing open and writing unencrypted. Also snapshot the object to a quarantine bucket.

Arun P: We can either 1) temporarily restore the revoked grant for remediation, or 2) download + re-encrypt using our remediation role. Prefer #1 for fewer object changes, but must be tightly timeboxed.

Maya C: containment plan: 1) block restores for tenant-77 snapshots, 2) flip uploader feature-flag to prevent new uploads, 3) run a bucket scan for objects with no SSE in 03:30-04:15 window.

Sasha L: I'm spinning up inventory job `s3-sse-scan-20260510` now. Also capturing /var/log/uploader on instances that reported uploads in timeframe.

Arun P: I'll request a temporary KMS grant for `remediate-role` with 15m TTL. All actions will be logged. We should also add a remediation note to the snapshot metadata after re-encrypt.

Maya C: long-term fixes: make uploader fail-closed on missing CMEK grants, add preflight grant check in deploy pipelines, and add an integration test that revokes grants in staging to ensure no clear uploads. Filing bug in tracker.

encops-bot: task-created TSK-20260510-3 "remediate tenant-77 snapshot and audit logs" assignees=Arun P,Sasha L due=2026-05-11T12:00:00Z

Maya C: rolling back my IAM change for 10 minutes to allow remediation. Will monitor for further incidents. :white_check_mark:
